hints.title: Bit Length Transitions
hints.text: The number of bits in integer i increases by one each time i reaches a power of two.

hints.title: Shift and Append
hints.text: To append i in binary, shift the accumulator left by the bit length of i and add i.

hints.title: Apply Modulo Sequentially
hints.text: Apply modulo 10^9 + 7 after each shift and addition.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to strings and joining creates a string of length ~10^6, causing large overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pure bitwise left shifts and addition maintain the running result in O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should detect bit length changes using (i & (i - 1)) == 0 in constant time.
